notes: Supersedes v001 after its all-width spectral-gap construction violated the exact Gaussian-SGD mean-square stability condition through the omitted trace(Sigma)/B term. V002 keeps all frozen seeds, widths, fit window, and analysis gates, but uses a width-independent rank-64 gapped covariance padded by inactive modes. Primary evidence is exact population excess risk, local-power slope stability/drift, and width stability; global log-log R2 alone is not a classification gate. Polynomial canonical and sparse-target exponents must agree within 0.08 at width 4096. Spectral-gap exponential R2 must exceed power R2 by at least 0.05. Stretched-exponential and geometric-spectrum cases are diagnosed by structured local-slope drift/oscillation rather than rejected solely by a high power R2. Rapid-target behavior remains exploratory.
